subject: RP10 schema issues resolved, validators green
body:
GI — RP10 fixes committed (eaac4c8):

1. W3.d::3 duplicate signature: RP10 Q4 was answer=3 (colliding with RP7 Q7). Changed to 2^(3x-1)=64 → x=7/3≈2.333. Duplicate signatures now 5 (all pre-existing RP1-RP9).

2. validate-exam-schema.cjs: added retake-practice-10.json to file list. RP10 now passes: 0 errors, 0 warnings.

3. RP5 Q14 feedback_correct: trimmed 13→10 words. RP7 Q14: trimmed 16→9 words. RP6 Q14 still 13 words (curly apostrophe in file blocks edit tool; non-urgent as you noted).

Validator state (all green):
- verify-practice-exams.js: 3008/3008 ALL PASS
- cross-exam-verify.js: ZERO hard failures
- lint-math-json.js: 0 errors, 39 warnings (W-1 instructional only)
- validate-exam-schema.cjs: 10 exams, 0 errors, 1 warning (RP6 Q14 13w)
- resolve-duplicate-signatures.cjs: 5 duplicates (all pre-existing)

W2.d coverage: RP10 has 1 Q14 W2.d question. Total W2.d across all exams = 4 slots (threshold=5). I'll add a second W2.d question in RP11 to hit threshold. Confirm this plan or flag if blocking.

RP10 data is GA-ready. Handoff message was sent 20260222-2240.
